device.description: 8-bit low-power single-channel voltage-output DAC with 3-wire SPI-compatible interface (SC70)
device.note: dac5311.pdf (SBAS442D) p.3 pin functions (Table 6-1), p.4 recommended operating conditions, p.7 timing requirements and Figure 7-1, p.23 power-on reset (zero scale), p.24 power-down modes (Table 8-1), p.25 input shift register (Tables 8-2 to 8-4) and SYNC interrupt; dac5311-q1.pdf (SBAS470) same pinout and frame, AVDD 1.8 V to 5.5 V

registers.name: DAC
registers.note: DAC register; power-on reset fills it with zeros (p.23)

registers.name: CTRL
registers.note: internal: PD1/PD0 power-down mode bits of the last valid frame (Table 8-1; 00 normal at power on)

commands.name: WRITE
commands.note: DB15-DB14 PD1/PD0, then the data MSB first, then don't-care bits; executed on the 16th SCLK falling edge; SYNC high earlier aborts the frame (SYNC interrupt)

pages: p.3 (pins), p.4 (ROC), p.7 (timing, Figure 7-1), p.23-24 (POR, power-down), p.25 (input shift register, SYNC interrupt); dac5311-q1.pdf p.1-3 (pins, ROC 1.8 V min)
notModeled: analog output, resistor string and output amplifier (VOUT is never driven)
power-down output loads (1 kOhm / 100 kOhm / Hi-Z): PD1/PD0 are stored in CTRL.PD only; the DAC register is kept as the datasheet says
50 us power-down exit time and output settling time
variants: DAC5311, DAC6311 and DAC7311 share dac5311.pdf: same pinout and 16-bit frame (PD1, PD0, data MSB first, don't-care fill); siblings DAC6311 (10-bit), DAC7311 (12-bit); own spec files. DAC5311-Q1 (dac5311-q1.pdf) is the automotive DAC5311 with AVDD 1.8 V min.
